- Market evidence: https://github.com/logos-co/rfp/issues/185

## Required interface
```json
{
  "input": "canonical opportunity dossier and source evidence",
  "output": "testable deliverable, validation evidence and execution receipt"
}
```

## Acceptance tests
- [ ] reject missing or unverified source evidence
- [ ] produce a deterministic or bounded artifact
- [ ] record hashes and test evidence
- [ ] fail closed on legal, account, identity, payment and scope gates
- [ ] pass a fixture based on the originating opportunity type

## Promotion and budget
- Promote only after unit tests and one dry-run artifact; never infer external submission or revenue.
- Use existing infrastructure first; any new paid dependency requires explicit approval.

## Mandatory continuation
Re-run universal market qualification after promotion.

No external submission, account creation, legal acceptance or revenue claim is authorized by this internal issue.

`strategic` — strategic work is limited while the first verified payment remains zero.
